items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Well we had Talbot, Slow Drag, Elton Pornell, George Lewis, Lawrence Moreira and myself. That was the old regular lineup.

ctx.x: So sure enough when I got home she gave me a message and I went on out there and all us George, Lawrence, Drag and myself, four of us, we played a house party there for them. Yeah. Some white people that lived right at the corner from Drag's house. The following week George had another job for me playing at the St. Mary's Church front out there. We played that. The following week he had a job to play an advertising for a prize fight back at Pelican
